risk_summary: The disclosure is generally detailed and quantified, with strong operating performance and clear descriptions of comparable-sales methodology, non-GAAP adjustments, debt capacity, and credit ratings. Risk tone is cautiously positive but is moderated by COVID-19 uncertainty, the full drawdown of the revolving facility, covenant dependence, and potential effects of ratings changes. Non-GAAP flexibility and broad qualifying language may reduce comparability and transparency.
